policy: Canonical fixed-suite evaluation may exclude only explicitly enumerated non-target failures that are reproduced in upstream GOLD under the same archived reference environment. Raw upstream logs remain authoritative and are never rewritten.

excluded_tests.rationale: Non-target full-suite failure is present in buggy, benchmark-fixed, and upstream GOLD under the locked reference environment.

Added at the maintainer's request after replay. Fails on the fixed side in some runs and not in others (ExUnit shuffles test order; the same code passed with seeds 355350 and 361039 and failed with 191303 and 820772). It also fails on the buggy side in the replay. It was NOT run against upstream GOLD, so it is not shown to be a GOLD-reproduced residual.
